rules.fix: Start SKILL.md with a first line of exactly '---', write the frontmatter as a 'key: value' mapping (name, description), and close it with a '---' line.

source.section: file references (relative paths from the skill root)

rules.message: refs are forward-slash paths relative to the skill root{detail}
rules.fix: Write each reference as a forward-slash path relative to the skill folder (for example references/guide.md): {problems}

source.house: house rule: every local file reference resolves inside the skill folder; a reference found only from the enclosing git repo needs a review (README rule table; no dated record)

message.review: {detail} (works only when the skill runs inside that repo)

fix.fail: Create each missing file or remove its reference, and remove each reference that points outside the skill folder and the repo (an absolute path, a backslash, a '..' or symlink escape) or move that file into the skill folder and link it with a relative path: {refs}
fix.review: To use the skill outside the repo, put the files in the skill folder (scripts/ and the like). If the skill runs only inside the repo, say in the body that the paths are relative to the repo root and have a person confirm it: {refs}

source.section: file references (keep them one level deep from SKILL.md)

rules.message: no nested reference chains (files linked from SKILL.md link nothing SKILL.md doesn't){detail}
rules.fix: Keep each referenced file from referencing other files; link every file it needs directly from SKILL.md: {chains}
